The "Oversigt over de samlede indikatorresultater" provides a comprehensive evaluation of healthcare quality for patients with [[atrieflimren]], tracking 11 clinical and organizational indicators against predefined standards and historical performance from 2021/22 and 2022/23 [^src1]. The data, compiled under the auspices of the [[regionernes-kliniske-kvalitetsudviklingsprogram|Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram]], reveals a mixed landscape of target achievement, with only a subset of indicators meeting their required thresholds in the current reporting period [^src1].

Indicators that successfully met their numerical standards include Indikator 1 (initiation of anticoagulation within 30 days), which achieved 91.6% against a ≥90% target, and Indikator 2 (echocardiography performance), which reached 80.6% against an ≥80% target [^src1]. Clinical outcome indicators also performed well, with Indikator 5 (stroke incidence) meeting the ≤0.8 threshold at exactly 0.8, and Indikator 6 (intracranial bleeding incidence) meeting the ≤0.6 threshold at 0.5 [^src1]. The source summary additionally notes that Indikator 4b (annual S-creatinin measurement for DOAC patients) is considered to fulfill its standard, despite recording 93.9% against a stated ≥95% target [^src1].

Conversely, several indicators fell short of their goals. The most glaring outlier is Indikator 8, which tracks the provision of a structured education program within the first year of diagnosis; it recorded a mere 15.9% fulfillment against a ≥50% standard, missing the target by a wide margin [^src1]. Indikator 3 (TSH measurement) also significantly underperformed, reaching 76.0% against a stringent ≥95% standard [^src1]. Long-term anticoagulation adherence (Indikator 4a1, 4a2, and 4a3) showed a gradual decline over time, dropping from 89.1% at one year to 87.3% at five years, all missing the ≥90% standard [^src1]. Indikator 7 (severe bleeding incidence) recorded a rate of 2.1 but had no predefined standard for comparison, making it an outlier in the evaluation framework [^src1].

Despite missing its target, Indikator 8 demonstrated the most notable positive trend, nearly doubling its fulfillment rate from 8.2% in 2022/23 to 15.9% in the current period [^src1]. Indikator 2 also showed steady, year-over-year improvement, rising from 76.7% in 2021/22 to 79.0% in 2022/23, and finally crossing the 80% threshold in the current reporting period [^src1].

Summary: Tabellen sammenligner faktisk opfyldelse af de 11 indikatorer i 2023/24 med tidligere år, og viser at kun Indikator 1, 2, 4b, 5 og 6 opfylder deres standarder, mens Indikator 3, 4a1–4a3 og 8 ligger under deres respektive standarder.

- "Indikator 4b måler andelen af patienter med atrieflimren i behandling med direkte orale antikoagulantia (DOAC) med mindst 1 måling af P-creatinin årligt" — see [[quality-indicator-definition|Quality Indicator Definition]] ([[regionernes-kliniske-kvalitetsudviklingsprogram|Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram]]) [^src24]
- "Indikator 5 måler incidens af iskæmisk apopleksi blandt prævalente patienter med atrieflimren" — see [[quality-indicator-definition|Quality Indicator Definition]] ([[regionernes-kliniske-kvalitetsudviklingsprogram|Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram]]) [^src24]
- "Indikator 6 måler incidens af intrakraniel blødning blandt prævalente patienter med atrieflimren" — see [[quality-indicator-definition|Quality Indicator Definition]] ([[regionernes-kliniske-kvalitetsudviklingsprogram|Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram]]) [^src24]
- "Indikator 7 måler incidens af alvorlig blødning (tillempede International Society of Thrombosis and Hemostasis (ISTH) kriterier) blandt prævalente patienter med atrieflimren" — see [[quality-indicator-definition|Quality Indicator Definition]] ([[regionernes-kliniske-kvalitetsudviklingsprogram|Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram]]) [^src24]
- "Indikator 8 måler andelen af nydiagnosticerede patienter med atrieflimren som får et struktureret undervisningsprogram indenfor 1 år efter diagnosen er stillet" — see [[quality-indicator-definition|Quality Indicator Definition]] ([[regionernes-kliniske-kvalitetsudviklingsprogram|Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram]]) [^src24]
- "Såfremt de anførte 95% CI for indikatorværdien ikke omfatter standardværdien, kan det konkluderes, at afdelingen ligger enten over eller under den opstillede standard, og at forskellen i forhold til standarden ikke kan forklares ved tilfældig variation. Der foreligger med andre ord en statistisk signifikant forskel" — see [[statistical-interpretation|Statistical Interpretation]] ([[regionernes-kliniske-kvalitetsudviklingsprogram|Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram]]) [^src23]
- "Omfaatter 95% CI derimod standardværdien, er det ikke muligt at afgøre om indikatorværdien med sikkerhed adskiller sig fra den opstillede standard" — see [[statistical-interpretation|Statistical Interpretation]] ([[regionernes-kliniske-kvalitetsudviklingsprogram|Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram]]) [^src23]
